title: Autoregressive Decoding as a Martingale: Characterizing the Stochastic Dynamics of LLM Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of language tasks. At their core, autoregressive LLMs are conditional probability models that learn to approximate the next-token distribution given the preceding context. Despite this probabilistic nature, the stochastic dynamics of autoregressive decoding have rarely been investigated from a rigorous probabilistic perspective. In this work, we define the per-step prediction error as the difference between the sampled token indicator and the model's conditional predictive distribution, and prove that the cumulative error process is a martingale with respect to the decoding filtration, implying that its conditional first-order moment is identically zero. translated_title: 自回归解码作为鞅：刻画大语言模型生成的随机动力学
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在广泛的语言任务中取得了显著的成功。本质上，自回归LLM是条件概率模型，学习在给定前文上下文的情况下逼近下一个词元的分布。尽管具有这种概率性质，自回归解码的随机动力学却很少从严格的概率论视角得到研究。在本工作中，我们将每步预测误差定义为采样词元的指示变量与模型条件预测分布之差，并证明累积误差过程是关于解码信息流的鞅，这意味着其一阶条件矩恒为零。除了这一阶性质之外，我们还推导出该鞅序列二阶行为的闭式表达式：其可料二次变差可简化为 $\sum_t(1-p(y_t\mid y_{<t})$（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次从严格概率论视角将LLM自回归解码建模为鞅，证明累积预测误差过程关于解码信息流是鞅且一阶条件矩恒为零，并进一步给出其可料二次变差的闭式表达式，从而系统刻画了LLM生成过程的随机动力学。
en_tdlr: This work models autoregressive decoding of LLMs as a martingale, proving that the cumulative prediction error process is a martingale with respect to the decoding filtration with identically zero conditional first-order moment, and deriving a closed-form expression for its predictable quadratic variation, thereby rigorously characterizing the stochastic dynamics of LLM generation.
